what: Woodward makes control systems for aircraft and engines: fuel systems and actuators for jet engines and airframes, and controls for industrial gas turbines, engines and power generation.
customers: Jet engine and airframe manufacturers, airlines, industrial turbine makers and heavy equipment producers.
money: fuel systems, actuation and controls for commercial and defence aircraft
controls for gas turbines, engines and power generation
moat: Components certified into engine and aircraft programmes, which are then supplied and serviced for the decades those platforms stay in production and in service.
risks: Aerospace build rates depend on Boeing and Airbus delivery schedules
Industrial demand from China trucks has been weak
It pays only a small dividend
Supply chain constraints have limited deliveries
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year and about 14% a year over three years
Return on invested capital of 15% with low debt
Gas turbine demand for data centre power is lifting the industrial side
watch: Aerospace aftermarket revenue and industrial turbine orders.
